propositions: Plan review PASS verdict does not sign and persist an attestation by default on public routes, leaving no durable gate artifact despite consuming full LLM cost
Default signing behavior lacks test coverage at the real parser/CLI and library boundaries, making it an undefended invariant vulnerable to silent regression
Every mutating plan-review entry point (CLI review-plan and library review_plan) must converge on signing PASS by default with explicit --no-sign or sign=False to opt out
BLOCK, INDETERMINATE, degraded, and local-source results must never sign; signing-failure on PASS returns retryable disposition pointing to sign-review recovery
Re-invoking default operation with current claim-valid attestation must reuse it idempotently without LLM call or duplicate signature
CLI help and documentation must state sign-on-PASS default, explicit opt-out syntax, never-sign verdicts, and sign-review recovery path
